slides.title: Make your matches look like TV
slides.text: New cameras, a replay wipe and player cards. One click to install each, one click to turn it off.

slides.title: New camera angles for every ball
slides.text: Pulse tracks lofted shots from the air; Cinema stays low and long-lens. Pick one in Settings › Camera.

slides.title: Replays that cut in like TV
slides.text: Dark panels close on a blue seam, then open over the replay. Works in every competition and with any scoreboard mod.

slides.title: Player cards with a broadcast look
slides.text: Walk-in, milestone and bowler cards in dark glass, in each team's colours. Your scoreboard stays as it is.

slides.title: Try new mods before they're public
slides.text: Members get early-access mods, can ask for new ones, and get help if something breaks.
